# Step - to_table

`to_table` · category: [Running and showing results](../../traversal/step_reference.md#running-and-showing-results)

Runs the traversal and renders its results as a text table.

## Forms

```text
to_table()
to_table(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").to_table()
```
